content:
Alex W: Quick runway check — dropping regional snapshot for this week. Pls paste brief cluster-level GPU hours vs committed, any preemptible / spot risk, and known networking constraints. Trying to decide if we need emergency burst buys or traffic steering. :eyes:
Priya S: US-W: committed 48kh, projected 52k (+8%). Preemptible risk low (5% job mix). EU-N: committed 32kh, projected 40k (+25%) — storage egress causing retries on rerank jobs, driving extra token cost. APAC: committed 18kh, projected 15k (-17%) — spare runway.
Marco R: EU-N network spikes on Tue 03:10-03:40 UTC, dropped throughput ~20% for the span. Root cause was transient BGP flap in provider region and perf degraded for small KV cache reads.
Jenna L: Model bursts this week are concentrated on eu-north / us-west with two Canary experiments. Can we throttle canaries to preserve headroom? Suggest batch_size cap of 32 for canaries for next 48h.
Samir K: Ops suggestions: 1) Shift low-priority batch jobs to APAC night window (00:00-06:00 PT) — should free ~6k hours. 2) Enable ephemeral micro-burst pool in US-W for next 72h (requesting +10% on dedicated). 3) Backstop: spot buffer increase to 12% in eu-north to hedge scheduling delays.
Alex W: Good. Priya — can you sanity-check the 6k reclaimable hours from APAC? Marco — any mitigation from network side short-term?
Priya S: Confirmed ~6.2k reclaimable if we shift the queued evals. I'll annotate the schedule.
Marco R: Short-term mitigation: enabled TCP pacing on the EU hash ring, reduced retry window. Should reduce noisy retries. Longer term we have provider ticket 87621.
ops-bot: Incident alert posted — EU-N egress jitter 03:10 UTC, severity: low, link: https://incident/87621 :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: us-west node pool patching on 2412400000 (next Thu) — ETA 45m. Will be moving some pods to dedicated-burst pool.
Jenna L: I'll pause the two canaries in eu-north for 24h and lower batch cap.
Samir K: I can kick the burst request to capacity team now. If approved, we should have provisioning within 6 hours (cloud-side).
Alex W: Decision: 1) Shift queued evals to APAC night — Priya to run. 2) Pause eu-north canaries 24h — Jenna. 3) Toggle spot buffer to 12% eu-north — Samir, please monitor cost delta. 4) Enable micro-burst in US-W if capacity team greenlights — Samir.
Priya S: On it, will post schedule in the night-shift channel when done. :white_check_mark:
Samir K: Filed capacity request ticket #CR-4521. ETA 6h. Will post updates here.
Alex W: Thanks all. Will revisit in tomorrow morning run at 14:00 UTC. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
